preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n0, int) and isinstance(n1, int) and isinstance(n2, int) and 0 <= n0 <= 100 and 0 <= n1 <= 100 and 0 <= n2 <= 100 and (n0 + n1 + n2 > 0) for n0, n1, n2 in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n0, n1, n2 are integers between 0 and 100 inclusive, and their sum is strictly positive.
It is guaranteed that a valid binary string exists for the given n0, n1, n2.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(all(c in '01' for c in line) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a binary string containing only '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: all(count_pairs(line, 0) == n0 and count_pairs(line, 1) == n1 and count_pairs(line, 2) == n2 for line, (n0, n1, n2) in zip(output_lines, test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the generated string has exactly n0 pairs of '00', n1 pairs with exactly one '1' ('01' or '10'), and n2 pairs of '11'.
